# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so. results.title: Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

results.content: As reported by USA TODAY on Aug. 12, a recent poll from Economist/YouGov placed the president's approval ratings at a "new low," with one in three Americans, or 33%, of respondents approving of his job performance, according to the results. USA TODAY described this as the "lowest approval rating" that the president has seen in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025.
